approach_explanation: We cleaned the data by engineering fault-signal features (sensor missingness flags, duplicate-input flag) instead of deleting anomalies, since these patterns perfectly predicted validity. We tested six models for each task; ExtraTrees (classification) and RandomForest (regression) were selected after 5-seed cross-validation confirmed genuine, reproducible gains over simpler baselines. A tuned probability threshold (0.1967) replaced the default 0.5 to correct for class imbalance.
